subject: Vendor Onboarding: Invoice Frequency & Early Payment Options
messages:
From: Atlas Data Accounts <accounts@atlasdata.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@atlasdata.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas Data - Onboarding packet and payment cadence question

Hi David,

Thanks for taking the time on the call today. Attached is our completed onboarding packet and a copy of our W-9. A few items to confirm so we can map to your PO flow:

- We submit invoices biweekly (every other Friday) unless you prefer monthly consolidated invoices.
- Standard payment term on our side is Net 45. We do offer a 1.75% early-pay discount for Net 15 / payment within 15 days if Redwood can support faster remittance.
- Please confirm the PO number placement and whether invoices should be routed to payments@redwood.com or uploaded to your vendor portal.

Attachments: Atlas_Onboarding_Form.pdf (onboarding form), W9_AtlasData.pdf

Appreciate the guidance—Emily will follow up with the PO template if needed.

Best,

Accounts Payable Team
Atlas Data
accounts@atlasdata.com

---
Note: If you need our PO template instead of your standard PO, Emily can send it.

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Data - Onboarding packet and payment cadence question

Hey Emily / AP team,

Thanks for sending the packet — received and uploaded to our vendor queue. Quick answers:

- Preferred routing: invoices should be sent to payments@redwood.com and include the Redwood PO number in the subject line (PO-#####). We will also accept uploads to the vendor portal; Monica will enable your account once onboarding is complete.
- Default Redwood net term is Net 30 for new vendors, but we can discuss Net 45 for recurring services where billing cadence aligns.
- Early-pay discounts need Finance sign-off; please outline the discount and the trade-offs (e.g., which invoices would qualify).

Cc'ing Grace (Procurement) and Monica (Vendor Ops) to finalize portal access and PO sequencing.

Can you confirm whether you prefer biweekly invoices to be combined into a single monthly invoice for Redwood's AP? Consolidated monthly billing simplifies reconciliation on our side.

Thanks,
David
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: PO_Template.xlsx]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Atlas Data Accounts <accounts@atlasdata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Data - Onboarding packet and payment cadence question

Emily / Atlas team —

Welcome! A couple of procurement items to close out:

1) PO process: Redwood issues a single monthly PO per vendor for recurring services. If Atlas prefers to keep biweekly invoices, we will require each invoice to reference the monthly PO and include a line-item sequence number. That keeps AP matching simple.

2) Terms: Our standard is Net 30. Net 45 can be accommodated for vendors with a valid SOW and steady monthly spend > $10k. Could you share a 3-month spend estimate so we can evaluate?

3) Early-pay: Finance (Rishi) has requested a short memo outlining the early-pay discount structure (discount %, which invoice dates apply, whether partial invoices can be discounted).

Monica — please provision portal access (vendor id: pending) and confirm preferred invoice file naming convention.

Emily — if you want to propose consolidated monthly invoices (preferred by Redwood), send a sample consolidated invoice for our AP to validate.

Thanks,
Grace
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

> On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 10:05 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Quick answers:
> > - Preferred routing: invoices should be sent to payments@redwood.com ...

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@atlasdata.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts@atlasdata.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Data - Onboarding packet and payment cadence question

Hi Grace / David —

Thanks for the clarity. A few specifics to help Finance decide:

- Typical monthly run-rate (projected): ~$22,500 (based on expected query volume and support hours).
- We can consolidate biweekly invoices into one monthly consolidated invoice that lists each service date range and line items — attaching a sample consolidated invoice for your AP team.
- Early-pay offer: 1.75% off invoice if paid within 15 calendar days. Applies to full monthly consolidated invoice only (not partial). We cannot apply the discount to individual line-item partial settlements.

Attached: consolidated_sample_invoice.pdf

If Redwood is willing to move to Net 30 with a 1.0% early-pay for payment within 10 days (instead of Net 45), we could accept that as an alternate. Open to negotiation.

Best,
Emily Chen
Head of Finance Operations
Atlas Data
emily.chen@atlasdata.com

[attachment: consolidated_sample_invoice.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Data - Onboarding packet and payment cadence question

Team / Emily —

I've reviewed the estimate and the early-pay proposal. Proposal options that Finance will accept:

Option A — Standard: Net 30, no early-pay.

Option B — Net 30 with 1.0% early-pay if paid within 10 calendar days (applies to full consolidated monthly invoice).

Option C — Net 45 with 1.75% early-pay within 15 calendar days, but Redwood requires a 6-month minimum commit and a signed SOW; Finance will also ask for a 30-day pre-funding buffer during the initial 2 months of billing.

Please confirm which option Atlas prefers. Once selected, Procurement (Grace) will generate the PO terms and Vendor Ops (Monica) will complete the portal provisioning. We'll also document the chosen option in HubSpot (HS-54321).

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
